For a private vulnerability report, use the contact in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md). The audit output names Pygments and Requests, so it reports advisories about those dependencies; it does not establish a vulnerability in Rich.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
